'''Pelugrotoa''', officially the '''Republic of Pelugrotoa''' and historically known as [[Ilythichan]] (the official name until 1709), is a country in East [[Mahea]]. With a [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|population of nearly 348 million]], it spans 2,581,890 square kilometres (996,873 sq mi). Pelugrotoa is bordered to the north by [[Inania]], to the west by [[Lieri]], [[Seytinemas]] and [[Taing]], and [[Byllu]] and [[Isnti]] to the south by the [[Adrad Sea]]; it also shares maritime borders with [[Sunsokua]] to the east and [[Sadain]] to the southeast. [[Thavrin]] is the state capital, while the largest city is [[Havok]].

The Pelugrotoan people [[Pelugrotoan Migration|migrated]] from northern [[Mahea]] to [[Kasive savana]] from the 7th to 11th centuries. Kingdoms such as the [[Darahn Sunm]], [[Amrein]], and [[Keisian Hieschlichs]] ruled the region, competing with Pelugrotoan states such as the Kingdoms of [[Kingdom of Mervan|Mervan]], [[Mikrolle Kingdom|Mikrolle]], [[Eaalis]], and [[Farones]]. Ayuman contact began in 1408 with a [[Taval|Tavalan]] diplomatic mission to the [[Quadiur Dynasty]], which became a regional power by the middle of the 14th century. [[Quadiur Dynasty|Quadiur]] reached its peak during the 16th century, until it was defeated in the [[Rivik Crisis]] in 1612. Many rebellions broke out in the distant provinces. [[Queen Nefersi]] quickly reunified the fragmented territory and established the short-lived [[Nefersi Dynasty]] (1614–1634), of which she was the only Queen. She was succeeded in 1634 by her [[Son Mada]], the first [[Wikipedia:Monarch|monarch]] of the former [[Yachi dynasty]]. Throughout the era of Ayuman [[imperialism]] in [[Mahea]], Pelugrotoa positioned itself as a close ally to [[Easuhura]] in 1634, after the Queen of Easuhura [[Easuhuran - Pelugrotoan relations|married]] one of Queen Nefersi's sons. Pelugrotoa was one of the few states in the region to avoid total [[Wikipedia:Colonization|colonisation]] by foreign powers, although it was often forced to make [[Pelugrotoan unequal treaties|trade and legal concessions in unequal treaties]]. The Pelugrotoan system of government was centralised and transformed into a [[Wikipedia:Absolute_monarchy|unitary absolute monarchy]] during the late 17th century. During the [[Great Imperial War]], Pelugrotoa remained officially neutral but covertly [[Pelugrotoan involvent in The Great Imperial War|supported Easuhura]] — a strategic decision aimed at renegotiating the [[Pelugrotoan unequal treaties|unequal treaties]]. Following a [[Pleugrotoan Revolution|revolution]] in 1679, it became a [[Wikipedia:Presidential_system|presidential republic]] with the monarchy fleeing to [[Abraria]], changing its official name to Pelugrotoa. In reaction, [[Easuhura]] then invaded and [[Reinstatement the Pelugrotoan monarchy|reinstated the monarchy]], becoming an ally of Easuhura in the [[Red War]] against [[Ashain]]. In the early 1700s, a [[1702 Pelugrotoan military coup|military coup restored]] the monarchy's total influence in the country, kicking out the in [[Easuhura|Easuhurans]]. 

Apart from a brief period of [[Wikipedia:Elective_dictatorship|parliamentary dictatorship]] in the 1710s, Pelugrotoa has periodically alternated between [[Wikipedia:Democracy|democracy]] and [[Wikipedia:Military_dictatorship|military rule]]. In the 1740s, the country has been in continual political conflict between supporters and opponents of twice-elected High Minister of Pelugrotoa [[Rushi Salainatra]], which resulted in two [[Wikipedia:Coup_d%27%C3%A9tat|attempted coups]] (in [[1744 Pelugrotoan military coup|1744]] and [[1749 Pelugrotoan military coup|1749]]), along with the establishment of its current constitution, a nominally democratic government after the [[Pelugrotoan 1750 general election|1750 general election]], and large [[Pro-democracy protests in Pelugrotoa|pro-democracy protests]] in 1750s, which included unprecedented demands to reform the state. Since 1757, the military was removed from all seats of power; in practice, however, structural advantages in the [[Pelugrotoan constitution|constitution]] have ensured the military's continued influence in politics. 

Pelugrotoa is a [[Wikipedia:Great_power|Major power]] in global affairs and a founding member of the [[Mahea Petroleum Union]]. It has the [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|fourth-largest economy]] in Mahea and the third-largest in the world by PPP, and it [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|ranks forthth by nominal GDP]]. Pelugrotoa is classified as a [[Wikipedia:Developing_country|developing economy]], with [[Wikipedia:Manufacturing|manufacturing]], [[Wikipedia:Agriculture|agriculture]], and [[List of countries by proven oil reserves|oil]] as leading sectors.
